name: sharepoint-provisioning-execution
description: Real PnP.PowerShell tenant-write executors for site columns, content types, and lists/libraries -- create, update, and delete, plus content-type-to-list attach/detach and list settings updates. Consumes plan JSON from sharepoint-provisioning's dry-run reconciliation modules (or hand-authored plan JSON for verbs that module doesn't plan yet). Every script is dry-run by default, gated behind -Execute plus an operation-specific -ConfirmToken. Extracted from sharepoint-migration-planning 2026-08-18 -- that plugin's own scope is planning only (dependency-graph analysis, wave-order computation); it never shipped tenant transport by design, and these executors had drifted into it by accident.
